requirement.value: Entropist or Reaper (Necromancer) mastery + both the Drain Spirit and Drain Vigor spells

system.description: When you cast Drain Spirit or Drain Vigor you recover the full MP or HP the target lost instead of half, and Drain Spirit's MP loss increases by 5 at level 20+ and by 10 at level 40+. This is an Entropist skill with the Reaper bolted on: both Drain spells are Entropist spells and the Reaper's own list contains neither, so a single-class Reaper cannot use it — what survives for them alone is Raising. Say it at build time.
